name: ga4gh-service-info skill
summary: Fetch a GA4GH Service Info document (the standard `/service-info` endpoint) from a configured service and report its id, name, type, organization, and version
description: Bundled Claude Code / MCP skill for GA4GH Service Info, shipped alongside the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-ga4gh-service-info` Cordis plugin and standalone MCP server in the `ga4gh-plugins` monorepo. Fetch a GA4GH Service Info document (the standard `/service-info` endpoint) from a configured service and report its id, name, type, organization, and version. Use when the user asks what a GA4GH service is, wants to check a GA4GH-compliant service's metadata, or needs to verify GA4GH Service Info standard compliance.
